legend.W: Diameter of hub (catalog W; Class 125: diameter at base of hub)
legend.K: Diameter of weld neck at weld end (catalog K; Class 125: diameter of hub at bevel)

legend.Y2: Length through hub, threaded / slip-on / socket weld (catalog Y2; Class 125: slip-on; Class 2500: threaded only)
legend.Y3: Length through hub, lap joint (catalog Y3)
legend.T: Thread length, minimum, threaded flanges (catalog T)
legend.B1: Bore of weld neck and socket weld flange (catalog B1); listed for Standard bore in Classes 150/300 and Extra-Strong bore in Class 600 unless purchaser specifies; omitted where catalog prints 'to be specified by purchaser' (Classes 125, 900, 1500, 2500)
legend.B2: Bore of slip-on and socket weld flange, minimum (catalog B2; Class 125: slip-on bore)
legend.B3: Bore of lap joint flange, minimum (catalog B3)

legend.D: Depth of socket, socket weld flanges (catalog D)
legend.holeDia: Diameter of bolt holes (printed fraction expressed as exact decimal)
legend.boltDia: Diameter of bolts, as printed (fractional string)
legend.THSO: catalog combined 'Threaded & Slip-On' calculated weight column, pounds
legend.weights: calculated/approximate weight, pounds (Class 125: catalog 'Approx. Weight' WN and SO columns; other classes: pp. 99-104)

reducingFlanges.source: p. 98, Reducing Slip-On and Threaded Flanges - All Classes
notes: Hub dimensions shall be at least as large as those of the standard flange of the size being reduced to; flanges reducing to sizes smaller than Groups I, II and III may be made from blind flanges.

Class 150 reducing flanges have no counter bore. Class 300 and higher have counter bore depth (q) 0.25 in. for NPS 2 and smaller tapping, 0.38 in. for NPS 2 1/2 and larger; counter bore diameter (Q) equals Z of the corresponding threaded flange.
Minimum effective thread length is at least dimension T of the corresponding pressure class threaded flange.
